note: Re-judged 2026-11-02 by an independent auditor who authored none of the change. RFC 7999 Section 3.2: "A BGP speaker receiving an announcement tagged with the BLACKHOLE community SHOULD add the NO_ADVERTISE or NO_EXPORT community as defined in [RFC1997], or a similar community, to prevent propagation of the prefix outside the local AS." The only edit to test/plugin/community-blackhole-noexport.ci since the last judgement is a965ee38fb, which names bgp-filter-community:ingress in the bgp-level import chain: the community settings now run only as chain members, and checkCommunityMembers (chain_member.go) refuses a blackhole-propagation setting whose import chain does not name that member. No input, expect, reject or requirement-tag line changed. The member is answered by evaluateCommunityFilter -> ingressFilter -> applyIngressFilter -> blackholePropagationGuard, and ingressFilter logs "community ingress applied ... blackhole-propagation=no-export" only when the payload was modified; with no tag, strip or scrub configured, that modification can only be the guard adding NO_EXPORT, and the fixture observer additionally requires RIB queries for 65535:666 and 65535:65281. The three Go units (TestRFC7999BlackholeFieldHasReader, TestRFC7999ReceivedBlackholeRouteGainsThePropagationCommunity, TestRFC7999RouteWithoutBlackholeGainsNoPropagationCommunity) are unchanged and carry revert records against blackholePropagationGuard. The .ci was not re-run by this auditor; its verdict rests on the unchanged expectations over the new production path. Verdict unchanged: enforced.
